clauseAudit.quote: Add one private recognized mount class: canonical immediate directories under exactly `/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Volumes`, with full basename grammar `^iOS_[0-9]{1,3}[A-Z]{1,3}[0-9]{1,6}[a-z]?$`. Names only classify a namespace; they never select, order or infer a runtime. Preserve the existing immediate-name validation for all Volumes entries. Strict ancestors from `/` through the fixed Volumes namespace must be nonsymlink directories, uid0 and not group/other writable. There is no writable-ancestor exception above these mounts.
clauseAudit.assessment: Exact fixed namespace/full grammar, canonical immediate names, strict root-owned ancestors. Real second class justifies private variation; no public arbitrary path policy.
clauseAudit.ruleSources: codebase-design: two actual variations; v3 finite ancestry rules

clauseAudit.quote: Require a fresh bounded `/usr/sbin/diskutil info -plist <exact canonical mount root>` before and after every metadata conversion and every runtime listing. Require exact MountPoint and actual boolean Writable=false, WritableMedia=false and WritableVolume=false. Use the already shipped bounded XML parser, fixed executable/argv/environment and strict executable/Xcode validation. Bootstrap inspects only the finite namespace/mount-root chain and does not read runtime metadata or recursively ask its own verifier for a mount proof. Refuse missing, writable, mismatched, malformed, changed or uncertain proof. No cached mount proof authorizes a later read.
clauseAudit.assessment: Required exact mount point/typedfalse flags; finite bootstrap does not recursively prove itself or authorize metadata before proof; existing bounded parser/process authorization reused.

clauseAudit.quote: Within the confirmed mount, require every component to be on the mount root's device, nonsymlink, uid0 and gid0 or80. Directories allow only0755/0775; additionally01775 is allowed only at the exact `<root>/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Profiles/Runtimes/<bundle>.simruntime/Contents/Resources/RuntimeRoot`. Metadata leaves allow only0444/0644/0664, regular file, nlink1, at most65536 bytes. Reject other modes, setuid/setgid, world write, different owner/group/type, aliases and nested-device transitions. The actual modes remain to be measured; unsupported observations do not silently expand these sets.
clauseAudit.assessment: Finite descendant modes/group/device/type/link/size rules; RuntimeRoot exception exact; unsupported native observations cannot enlarge policy automatically.
clauseAudit.ruleSources: approved v3 mode and same-device policy

clauseAudit.quote: Support only the fixed Runtimes suffix and the three already supported Info/profile/SystemVersion plist leaf forms. Classify recognized mounted namespaces before allowedArtifactRoots so an artifact prefix cannot downgrade their trust. Invalid targets within a recognized namespace refuse rather than fall through to ordinary artifact authorization.
clauseAudit.assessment: Only existing three leaf forms; recognized namespace checked before artifact paths; invalid recognized targets refuse.

clauseAudit.quote: Compare full before/opened/final/after identity including path, dev/ino, uid/gid, type/full mode, size/nlink and ctime/mtime for every component; compare exact metadata bytes before and after conversion. Each proof must match the mount identity in the full path snapshot. Check the caller's shared signal at every bounded stage; wait for actual child close. Preserve64KiB input and ordinary combined output, exact Xcode Info131072 output exception,10s mount deadlines and mount-only SIGTERM→250ms SIGKILL escalation. Other child termination behavior is unchanged.
clauseAudit.assessment: Full path/handle identity, exact bytes and mount binding required; existing budgets and mount-only escalation retained. These are proposed requirements, not tested guarantees.

clauseAudit.quote: Inspect all supported roots and match only the caller's explicit CFBundleIdentifier; missing or duplicate matches refuse. Do not skip an older recognized mount merely because its name differs from the requested identifier. Recognized mounts must satisfy the new proof even if their permissions would also satisfy the old rule. Unrecognized valid legacy names retain the strict old branch; `iOS_fixture` therefore retains its existing accepted regression. No newest-runtime selection, runtime fallback, runtime download or public path override.
clauseAudit.assessment: All supported roots inspected; explicit unique metadata match only; existing iOS_fixture strict branch retained without newest/fallback/download.
clauseAudit.ruleSources: allocation-contract.md:76; ADR0009 explicit creation identity/no runtime download

clauseAudit.quote: Extend the existing private mounted-metadata boundary to represent the two exact namespace classes. clauseAudit.quote: Read-only proof explains why mounted group-write mode bits cannot write the currently observed volume. This remains a mode-based policy trusting host namespace managers: it does not attest ACLs, exclusive writers, atomic ancestor pinning or immunity to privileged concurrent replacement. Before/after identity and bytes detect observed changes. No filesystem mode repair, mount change, cleanup or device operation is proposed.
clauseAudit.assessment: Explicitly disclaims ACL/exclusive-writer/atomic-pinning guarantee; observed changes detection does not imply exhaustive concurrency immunity.
